subject: general
question: The ratio of the radius of the base and the height of a right circular cylinder is 3 : 2, and its volume is 19404 cm³. What is the curved surface area (in cm²) of the cylinder? (Take pi =(22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of radius and height of the cylinder = 3: 2

Volume = 19404 cm³

**Formula used:**

The curved surface area of the cylinder = 2πrh

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

Here,

r = radius

h = height

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8295f914ee35ae96ca260c4521ed78bceb4eb3a23b53057a24864f25f4d78df7.png] 

Let the radius of the base and height of the cylinder be 3x and 2x

So,

π × (3x)² × 2x = 19404

⇒ 9x² × 2x = 19404 × (7/22)

⇒ 18x3 = 6174

⇒ x³ = 6174/18

⇒ x3 = 343

⇒ x = 7

So, radius = 7 × 3 = 21 cm, and height = 7 × 2 = 14 cm

Now,

Curved surface area = 2π × 21 × 14

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × 21 × 14

⇒ 2 × 22 × 21 × 2

⇒ 1848

**∴ The curved surface area (in cm2) of the cylinder is 1848.**
